response.sql: WITH channel_rates AS (SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_fee_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE o.orderbase IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.orderbase), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fee_rate) AS rate FROM channel_rates) SELECT AVG(c.avg_fee_rate) AS mean_channel_fee_rate, AVG(c.avg_fee_rate - b.rate) AS mean_excess_over_benchmark FROM channel_rates AS c CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE c.avg_fee_rate > b.rate

assumptions.assumption: An order with NULL orderbase has no channel, so it is excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat NULL orderbase as its own channel.
